Abstract.AbstractText: Autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis (ARCI) is a heterogeneous group of disorders of keratinization. To date, ARCI has been associated with following genes: ABCA12, ALOX12B, ALOXE3, CERS3, CYP4F22, NIPAL4, TGM1, PNPLA1 and recently SDR9C7 and SULT2B1.1-6 Furthermore, seven patients from a large consanguineous family were described as ARCI due to a homozygous mutation in LIPN.7 However, the first symptoms appeared only from the age of 5 years and the criterion of a congenital form of ichthyosis is not fulfilled. In this study we report the clinical and molecular findings of seven ARCI patients who carried five previously unreported mutations in SDR9C7. This article is protected by copyright.
